name: Fieldset Group
summary: A legend gives a set of controls the subject they are answers to — with the fieldset quirks that make people give up on it, the role="group" alternative for when the name has to be a heading, and the "pick at least one" rule HTML has no way to express.
demoNote: Uncheck everything in example 4 and the group says what is wrong — a rule `required` cannot express. Example 5 locks the same group twice: `disabled` cascades and takes the keyboard with it, `aria-disabled` cascades to nothing and keeps the reason reachable.

contract.useWhen: Related controls under one question, named by a legend.
keyboard: one stop per control — a fieldset is not one stop
failureModes: role=group on a fieldset, replacing working semantics with hand-written ones
aria-label on the fieldset instead of a legend, so the group is named for AT and untitled on screen
the legend not the first child, where it stops being the name
the error on the fieldset's own description, which is read inconsistently — put the id on every control
a legend as a flex item, which older Safari refuses: wrap the body in a div
api: AC.createFieldsetGroup(root, options) -> { validate, count, inputs, element, destroy }
